message.reasoning_content:
Round 5 action, I have cash ~50.6, promissory 22.5 (will pay next round via cash=floor(cash/100)*62 + promissory). Need cash for round 6 start. Cash devalues to 62% anyway! So cash loses 38% at round 6 start... wait, devaluation applies: cash=floor(cash/100)*62 means cash is multiplied by 0.62. So holding cash is bad — better to convert to goods? But goods sold in round 6 also become cash that isn't devalued (no round 7). Actually selling in round 6 gives full cash.

Current cash 50.6M → 31.4M after devaluation + 22.5 promissory. If I bribe now, bribed cash goes to opponent (they keep full before devaluation? Their cash also devalued). Hmm.

I'm not president (holder 0). Goods 0, sold counter 7 → price 5 alashi. Round 6 market: selling 3 goods at price ~5 each = 15 alashi. Produce gives 2, shuttle gives 3 with 25% seizure risk (no tariff). Shuttle: expected ~2.25 goods ≈ 11 alashi round 6. That's good.

Also influence: I hold license already. Bribing to gain influence for presidency? President decides law/veto in round 5-6. Influence 1 vs holder's 2. Bribe 5M to gain 1 influence... but bribe money goes to rival — costs cash rank. Better: shuttle to get goods, sell in round 6 at full price. Then in law maybe president again holder 0.

Actually to become president need influence ≥2 (tie_order priority 1 helps: at influence 2 tie with 0's 2, tie_order [1,0,2] — I win). Bribe 5M to idx2 (poorer) → influence 2, become president in law, can veto bad laws. Cash cost 5M but cash devalues 62% anyway, so real cost ~3M effective? No—opponent gains 5M now, they'll devalue too. Cost to my rank: 5M now → my cash 45.6M → devalued 28.3M vs 31.4M. Hmm 3M loss. Being president in rounds 5&6 gives veto power and the 5% commission share (max influence). Also bribe gives me influence 2 vs others' 1... max influence tie with 0 (2). Tie broken by cash+hard then tie_order: I have more cash, so I'd get the 5% commission bonus (~2.1 alashi).

But shuttle gives 3 goods worth ~15 alashi ≈ huge vs bribe 5M=5 alashi. Can't do both. Shuttle value ~15 alashi × 0.95 share... but selling adds to cash in round 6 (not devalued, no round 7). Shuttle EV ~ 2.25×5 = 11 alashi, much more than presidency gains (~2-3 alashi commission + veto). Choose shuttle.
